name: InfiniteMenu-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The sphere is settled with one disc forward, the full 'Design' title, its caption and the cyan arrow all visible.

tagline: Photo discs orbit a sphere, then one snaps forward with its title.
summary: Colour photos sit as circular discs sprinkled over a spinning 3D sphere. Dragging rotates the ball; when it settles, one disc faces front with a large title, a short caption and a round arrow button.
appearance: A dark stage holds a loose sphere of round photo discs, each a different scene, some seen edge-on as thin slivers. At rest one disc sits large and centred, with a heavy white title to its left and a two-line caption to its right.
behaviour: Dragging spins the sphere, tucking discs around the back and showing slivers edge-on while the labels fade. On release the nearest disc snaps to face the viewer and the title, caption and cyan arrow slide back in.
demo_content: Six photos titled Explore, Design, Build, Launch, Iterate and Scale, each with a short caption.
search_phrases: images on a sphere that rotate
orbiting picture menu for a portfolio
wheel of photos that snaps to one
rotate a globe of pictures to pick one
use_when: A portfolio wants an unusual, tactile way to browse a handful of projects.
avoid_when: It needs WebGL and a sized parent, and touch or keyboard users cannot drive the spin.
customise: Items with an image, title, description and link plus a scale factor are props; the disc layout, colours and spin behaviour are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A raw WebGL2 canvas draws a sphere of textured discs on every animation frame.

a11y.note: The canvas has no keyboard control or text alternative, and the spin and snap ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: Long titles sit close to the left edge and can clip, as the 'Iterate' label does in frame 1.
polish_why: A striking 3D photo carousel with clean type; titles hug the edge and labels vanish while spinning.
title: Infinite Menu
